about: text: all twelve type roles, all five tones, mono, selectable, lines; Intl times in a pinned zone

json.title: Checkout latency above 4 s
json.summary: Checkout requests in eu-central slowed to a p95 of 4.2 s after the payment provider's TLS endpoint started rate-limiting our connection pool. A pool-size fix is deployed; latency is back under 600 ms and we are watching the evening peak before closing this.
json.impact: About 18% of checkouts between 14:02 and 15:10 CEST took longer than 4 s; 312 were abandoned.
json.recovery: Recovered: p95 is 580 ms since 15:10 CEST.

timeline.text: Payment provider rate-limits new TLS handshakes; our pool reconnects on every request.
Deployed checkout-api v2.14.1 with a persistent pool of 32 connections.

json.cause: A config change in v2.14.0 set the HTTP client's idle timeout to 0, so every request opened a new TLS connection to the provider.
json.logLine: 2026-09-21T12:02:14Z WARN pay.client dial tcp 18.194.3.7:443: rate limited (429)
